ns2:course.label: Off-Road Vehicle Mechatronics
ns2:course.description: (AG E 446) Emphasizes integrated skills in designing mechatronic systems with regard to off-road vehicles. Main topics include fundamentals for mechatronic systems design; modeling of off-road vehicle systems, on-vehicle information management, and intelligent vehicle controls. Prerequisite: ABE 425 or ME 461 or MFGE 430; ECE 486 or ME 460; or equivalent.
